patch_rms_norm_forward: patch the diffusers RMSNorm forward method to support torch NPU, torch >=2.4, and fallback implementations
apply_rms_norm_torch_npu: apply RMS normalization using torch_npu.npu_rms_norm when NPU hardware is available
apply_rms_norm_torch_24: apply RMS normalization using nn.functional.rms_norm for PyTorch versions 2.4 and above
apply_rms_norm_fallback: apply RMS normalization with a manual variance computation fallback for older PyTorch versions
handle_half_precision_rms_norm: handle half-precision dtype conversion for weight and hidden states during RMS normalization
